case_name: OpTC Day3 Malicious Upgrade on Sysclient0351
timezone_note: Ground-truth wall-clock times use EDT (-04:00); the UTC window is locked before the 25Sept eCAR file is inspected.
ground_truth_summary: A vulnerable Notepad++ update on Sysclient0351 downloaded a malicious update.exe reverse-TCP Meterpreter payload. The payload connected to the attacker infrastructure, then migrated from PID 1932 (f.exe) to PID 1256 (lwabeat).

attack_stages.summary: The Notepad++ update path downloaded and executed malicious update.exe.
The reverse-TCP Meterpreter payload connected to attacker infrastructure associated with 53.192.68.50:8080.
Meterpreter migrated from PID 1932 (f.exe) to PID 1256 (lwabeat).

required_ecar_subsets.reason: Official host batch and date containing the locked Sysclient0351 Day3 window.

data_quality_notes: The local AIA-351-375 password ZIP is from 23Sep19, not 25Sept, and cannot be used for R07.
The local 24Sep AIA-201-225 archive covers Sysclient0203 only through 09:55 EDT, before its 15:42 EDT red-team event, and cannot be used for R07 or a Day2 substitute.
R07 was selected and time-locked after XGBoost v0.1 parameters were frozen but before the correct 25Sept event file was inspected.
notes: C10 adds a new attack day and Meterpreter/malicious-upgrade chain within OpTC. It is a parameter-locked cross-day robustness case, not a fourth independent source family.
